security.controlled_access: 24/7 security with cameras, guards, and card access after hours
security.incident_reporting: Security logs incidents and communicates to management
security.tenant_access_cards: Each employee must have their own card; lost/stolen cards must be reported immediately

ventilation.air_quality: CO2 levels ~550 ppm depending on occupancy
ventilation.humidity_control: Outdoor air; can dehumidify but not humidify

overtime_HVAC.request_deadline: 4:00 PM on the preceding business day

restaurant.name: Bayberry Garden
restaurant.description: Bayberry Garden offers a uniquely New England-inspired dining experience that melds creative seasonal dishes, a sustainable raw bar, and exploratory wine, cocktail, and beer lists, with immersive restaurant design.

event_policies.common_areas: Includes outdoor areas (excluding CIC's third-floor patio) and lobby areas, including the 7th floor if vacant
event_policies.event_requests: Submit at least one week before the event for approval
event_policies.prohibited_events: Political events in common areas are forbidden
event_policies.vendor_insurance: All vendors must provide COI before the event
event_policies.legal_contracts: Third-party events require a 25-page Right of Entry contract and one month's notice

cleaning_fees.additional_info: Cleaning fees apply for events with alcohol or if additional cleaning is needed. The event host must arrange cleaning services.

event_policies.event_staffing: Additional security and cleaning may be required for larger events or alcohol service

event_vendors.workers_compensation: Statutory limits as required by law
event_vendors.additional_insured: Owner, property management, and affiliates must be named as additional insureds

common_issues.lighting: For burnt-out bulbs or flickering lights, submit a work order via Building Engines.
common_issues.HVAC: For heating or air conditioning problems, submit a request through Building Engines.
common_issues.plumbing: For leaks, clogs, or water issues, submit a work order through Building Engines.
common_issues.electrical: For power issues, broken outlets, or wiring concerns, use Building Engines.
common_issues.doors/windows: For broken locks, stuck doors, or cracked windows, request service via Building Engines.

parking.location: Clifford Street Parking Facility, 75 Clifford St, Providence, RI 02903
parking.prox_cards: Required for entry/exit; cannot be shared
parking.payment_deadlines: Fees due by the 1st of each month
parking.late_fees: Cards deactivated after the 5th; reinstatement requires a $10 fee

bike_storage.availability: Indoor and outdoor storage, no overnight storage allowed
bike_storage.access: Card access required; request via property management
